import sys

def main():
    str_input = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    
    res = 0
    run_length = 1
    
    for i in range(1, len(str_input)):
        if str_input[i] == str_input[i - 1]:
            run_length += 1
        else:
            if run_length % 2 == 0:
                res += 1
            run_length = 1
    
    if run_length % 2 == 0:
        res += 1
    
    print(res)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
